text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you looking for something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm looking for the moxibustion kit, you see...
Can't seem to find it anywhere~...

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: M-Moxibustion...? We haven't stocked any moxa cones, you know...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see. Ah, well, lately I just
haven't been able to shake off this fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, do you happen to have a green bamboo stalk?
You know, the kind you step on to massage your feet—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute seems to be far more fatigued from the race than expected. It would be best to reconsider the schedule...
